cond_0001.intro: Looking for an experienced geotechnical engineer who wants to be a part of a well-established team of geologists and engineers. Our Senior Geotechnical Engineer is nearing retirement, and our entry-level engineers aspire to develop in the geotechnical field. The right candidate will lean into this experience gap, collaborating with established senior staff and mentoring junior staff. Our organization currently employs 10 geologists, of whom 5 are Senior Engineering Geologists, and 11 materials testing technicians and special inspectors supporting three fully accredited materials testing laboratories, located in [Location masked]. One of the things we enjoy is seeing projects develop from concept through construction. The right candidate will lean into this experience gap, collaborating with established senior staff and mentoring junior staff. Our organization currently employs 10 geologists, of whom 5 are Senior Engineering Geologists, and 11 materials testing technicians and special inspectors supporting three fully accredited materials testing laboratories, located in [Location masked]. One of the things we enjoy is seeing projects develop from concept through construction. Many of our geologists and engineers work collaboratively with our laboratory testing and special inspection staff to support projects during the construction phase.
cond_0038.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise in geotechnical engineering, with at least 5 years post-GE license, including:
Foundation design (shallow and deep)
Slope stability evaluation and retaining wall design
Seismic hazards (liquefaction, settlement, slope failure, etc.)
Ground improvement techniques
At least 5 years of proven project management experience
Bachelor's degree in civil/geotechnical engineering from an accredited four-year college or university required; advanced degree strongly preferred
California Registered Geotechnical Engineer (GE) License and ability/interest in obtaining [Location masked] GE license within 1 year
At least 5 years of demonstrated GE experience
Advanced knowledge of geologic and geotechnical conditions and engineering requirements in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements
Proven ability to help develop the technical aspects of [Company name masked]'s engineering and geotechnical services
Strong command of geotechnical software and tools for analysis and design
Substantial experience working with a materials testing laboratory

Our Senior Geotechnical Engineer is nearing retirement, and our entry-level engineers aspire to develop in the geotechnical field. The right candidate will lean into this experience gap, collaborating with established senior staff and mentoring junior staff. Our organization currently employs 10 geologists, of whom 5 are Senior Engineering Geologists, and 11 materials testing technicians and special inspectors supporting three fully accredited materials testing laboratories, located in [Location masked]. One of the things we enjoy is seeing projects develop from concept through construction. Many of our geologists and engineers work collaboratively with our laboratory testing and special inspection staff to support projects during the construction phase.
cond_0487.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
At least 10 years of geotechnical engineering experience, with 5 years post-GE license, including:
Foundation design (shallow and deep)
Slope stability evaluation and retaining wall design
Seismic hazards (liquefaction, settlement, slope failure, etc.)
Ground improvement techniques
At least 5 years of project management experience
Bachelor's degree in civil/geotechnical engineering from an accredited four-year college or university
California Registered Geotechnical Engineer (GE) License and ability/interest in obtaining [Location masked] GE license within 1 year
At least 5 years of GE experience
Working knowledge of geologic and geotechnical conditions and engineering requirements in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements
Interest/ability to help develop the technical aspects of [Company name masked]'s engineering and geotechnical services
Familiarity with geotechnical software and tools for analysis and design
Experience working with a materials testing laboratory
